text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could we form a heart with our
hands?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My father said something very impactful
on the
phone. He said my heart must be
one with my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
After much research, I had Falcon
upload
instructions on how to make a
heart together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
According to her, we must first pose,
and then we
take a picture... Say cheese,
Trainer.
